(#140) Use GPL (>= 3) License. drop terra_ prefix move rast_ functions scratch test LOO method. * Add sf_ prefix vector based approaches. Add datasets dataset loading function Add legend habitat buffer barrier plot - #66 Resolve internal issue raster might exactly aligned, add internal function align_to() drop_habitat_under_barrier(), fragment_habitat(), assign_patches_to_fragments(). update effective_mesh_size() connectivity_probability() go area_squared –> area_baseline. #128. help facilitate #124. habitat_connectivity(), habitat_connectivity_full(), sf_habitat_connectivity() now take either interpatch_distance buffer_radius (supply exactly one). lower-level habitat_buffer() sf_habitat_buffer() take buffer_radius directly. (#131) habitat_buffer() now warns buffer radius fine raster resolution (smaller one cell, clean multiple ) returns habitat unchanged instead erroring. (#131) New vignette vignette("interpatch-distance--resolution") interpatch distance, buffer radius, raster resolution interact. Fix shiny app’s interpatch-distance input, read wrong id. (#131) Add “patch_size” class habitat_connectivity() function, pave way attaching useful metadata data. (#133). Add patch_size S3 class: add pc_* accessor functions get: interpatch_distance, patches, res, species. Extend patch_size onto tibble Add various checking functions ensure can compare species, metrics together. change area parameter summarise/compare_connectivity connectivity remove use arguments, target_resolution aggregation_factor many functions really relevant spatial processing, really care resolution end day habitat_connectivity() now returns one-row connectivity-class landscape summary (n_patches, effective_mesh_ha, prob_connectedness, patch_area_mean, patch_area_total_ha, …) instead raw per-patch table. per-patch areas travel patch_size list-column, retrievable new patch_sizes() accessor. sf_habitat_connectivity() still returns per-patch table directly now. (#141) Rename per-patch class constructor patch_size() -> patch_size_tbl() (internal new_patch_size() -> new_patch_size_tbl()), freeing patch_sizes name new accessor . (#138) New habitat_connectivity_comparison() compares scenario baseline, one interpatch distances (buffer radii). one habitat barrier may differ baseline, change can attributed layer. errors differ, warns neither . (#140) New example data example_wren_habitat_scenario(), habitat scenario pair example_wren_habitat(). (#140) summarise_connectivity() habitat_connectivity() now return metrics full precision. prob_connectedness rounded 6 decimal places, coarse enough hide small changes scenario produces. (#140) Argument checks use call arg name function argument failed, called . compare_connectivity() gains scenario_name argument: optional label, e.g. “Scenario ”, appears first column every row. NA supplied, labelled unlabelled comparisons stack. (#35) New compare_scenarios() compares several scenarios one baseline, taking named list connectivity objects names become labels, returning four rows per scenario. (#35) habitat_connectivity_comparison() gains scenario_name, passed compare_connectivity(). (#35) New habitat_connectivity_scenarios() compares several scenarios one baseline starting layers, taking named lists habitat barrier scenario layers. scenario changes exactly one layer, baseline computed per distance shared every scenario. (#35) summarise_connectivity()’s default method now stores patch_size_tbl patch_size, patch_size_tbl method, compare_connectivity() works connectivity object built plain vector areas. (#35)

title: urbioconnect (development version)
text: interpatch_distance now full edge--edge distance two patches count connected. halved internally buffer radius, connectivity results differ previous versions; reproduce old output passing buffer_radius = old value. (#131) habitat_connectivity() return type changed per-patch patch_size_tbl one-row connectivity summary. Code relying per-patch columns (e.g. habitat_connectivity(...)$area) instead use patch_sizes(habitat_connectivity(...))[[1]]. (#141) compare_connectivity() now compare_connectivity(scenario, baseline). takes two one-row connectivity objects, output habitat_connectivity() summarise_connectivity(), returns four rows: baseline, scenario, change (scenario minus baseline) pct_change. longer S3 generic, patch_size_tbl default methods gone. (#140) summarise_connectivity() longer takes connectivity_baseline. Use compare_connectivity() compare baseline instead. (#140)
